## Changelog

- Dependency update from Renovate; the versions are in the table above and the release notes follow below.

packageRules.description: Pi itself (@earendil-works/*, legacy @mariozechner/*) is a manual round, not a bot PR. A Pi bump also changes the version and range in packages.lock.json (pi block), docs/install.md, config/features.json, README/NOTICE and the installer fixtures (tests/installer/setup.test.mjs, fake-pi.mjs, sleepy-pi.mjs), which no manager can update together, so Renovate would open an incomplete PR.
pi-intercom is a fork pin (git+https spec) carrying the hc transport; updates are taken by rebasing the fork, see docs/install.md. Remove this rule when pi-foreman returns to upstream.

customManagers.description: packages.lock.json pins (bump together with package.json; installer test requires equal pins). Matches the bundled packages in the packages array and also the pi block, which the Pi disable rule above keeps off the bot.
